about: A worked example of the spec -> block mapping, from bench/ecommerce/SPEC.md (a shop). atomSteps.mjs reads it as data: a recipe applies only where its anchor point matches the spec; its roles find the points that give a block its inputs (named groups); `templates` names the blocks.mjs code it lands; `files`, `steps` and the role texts are filled with those inputs ({name}) and the matched point ids ({role}), so no point id or domain word is written in code. A spec in other words (another domain) matches no recipe here and is left to the generic seed and the builder.

roles.decided: cart block: a line per item with its quantity field and line total on the library list page
cart block: a quantity change updates the store and every total; 0 removes the line
cart block: a Remove button per line

extract.re: \bshipping is \$(?<fee>\d+(?:\.\d+)?), or \$0(?:\.00)? when the subtotal is \$(?<freeFrom>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) or more\b

roles.decided: cart block: the quoted totals and the shipping rule as written
roles.missing: the shipping rule is not in the form "shipping is $X, or $0.00 when the subtotal is $Y or more"

roles.decided: cart block: the quoted empty text, and no checkout when empty
cart block: the store keeps the lines in localStorage
cart block: the quoted checkout link

find.re: \blink whose name starts with "[^"]+"[^;]*number of items[^;]*;\s*it opens `\/[^`]*`

roles.decided: cart block: a CartLink "<label> (<count>)" in the app shell nav

find.re: \bfield labelled "[^"]+" \(default \d+, at least \d+\) and an? "[^"]+" button add

extract.re: \bfield labelled "(?<qtyLabel>[^"]+)" \(default (?<def>\d+), at least (?<min>\d+)\) and an? "(?<button>[^"]+)" button add[^]*?\bsays "(?<status>[^"]+)"

roles.decided: cart block: an AddToCart control (quantity, button, status) beside the detail page
roles.missing: the add point does not quote its field, default, minimum, button and status

whyNot.text: no fixture has the id, name and price a cart line needs
the cart page point does not quote its heading, quantity label and empty text

steps.service: {ids}: the cart lives in the browser (localStorage) as lines {id, qty}, shared by every feature, so it is a library service.
steps.usecase: The cart's items, count and totals{rule} for pages: useCart.
steps.link: {#link}: a link "{linkLabel} (<count>)" to {linkRoute}, for every page.
steps.nav: {#link}: every page shows the cart link: the app shell's nav.
steps.notShell: {layout} is not Line's app shell, so the cart link is the builder's call
steps.add: {#add}: "{qtyLabel}" (default {def}, at least {min}) and "{button}" add to the cart and say "{status}".
steps.page: {own}: {page} lists the cart's lines with their quantity fields and totals ("{heading}").

roles.decided: validated-submit: the quoted fields and checkbox on the library form page

find.re: \bshows a message for each invalid field \(

roles.decided: validated-submit: each quoted message as its field's rule (aria-invalid by TextField)

find.re: \border summary with each product, its quantity and the order total\b

roles.decided: cart block: the cart lines and total beside the form

find.re: "[^"]+" button places the order through a mock order service, empties the cart and opens `\/[^`]*`

extract.re: "(?<button>[^"]+)" button places the order through a mock order service, empties the cart and opens `(?<next>\/[^`]*)`

roles.decided: validated-submit then a mock order service; the cart is cleared and the route opened

extract.re: \bconfirmation page has the main heading "(?<doneHeading>[^"]+)"[^]*?\border number \(text starting "(?<numberPrefix>[^"]+)"\)[^]*?\blink "(?<doneLinkLabel>[^"]+)" to `(?<doneLinkRoute>\/[^`]*)`

roles.decided: the confirmation page on the library detail page, from the last order
roles.missing: the confirmation point does not quote its heading, order-number text and link

find.re: \bwith an empty cart says "[^"]+" with a link to the products\b

roles.decided: the cart's empty text and a link to the products instead of the form

whyNot.text: the {needs} block is not seeded, and the {feature} reads the {needs}
no point quotes the button that places the order and the route it opens
a message does not name its field, or a rule is not one of required, valid email, N digits

steps.atom: {ids}: the checkout form is validated against its rules before the order is placed, which is the validated-submit atom; copy it into the library atoms.
steps.service: {#place}: the order is placed through a mock order service in the app (no network).
steps.usecase: {#messages}: the form's rules ({fieldLabels}) as a schema for the validated-submit atom, then the order service.
steps.page: {#anchor}, {#summary}, {#empty}: {page} is the "{heading}" form with the order summary, or the empty-cart text.
steps.doneBase: {#confirm}: the confirmation page shows one order: {name} is based on the library DetailPage.
steps.done: {#confirm}: {page} says "{doneHeading}" with the order number, the products, the total paid and "{doneLinkLabel}".
